_comment: Ground-truth labels for the synthetic P3 dataset. READ ONLY BY backend/evaluate.py. The audit engine never imports or reads this file (MASTER.md principle: production audit code must not see ground truth).
notes: Innocent cases are clean sales whose documents agree and whose routes are plausible; they must not produce hard conflicts. The dataset's innocent-trap coverage is limited (no genuine-return credit note or shared-PO case in the pure P3 import path); extending it is a recommended next step.
